item.description: Consented assistance co-adaptation, accessibility-grounded desktop control, durable and scheduled autonomy, MCP tools, voice-first control while working, and fail-closed settings and approvals

item.title: Heliox OS 0.13.0 — Verified Autonomy and Runtime Hardening
item.description: Truthful outcomes, transactional settings, authenticated collaboration, coordinated multimodal control, bounded resources, and measured execution quality

item.title: Heliox OS 0.12.0 — Governed Intelligence and Handoff
item.description: Subscription-backed planning, local MCP, secure Air Handoff, verified integrations, and one governed cognitive runtime

item.title: Heliox OS 0.11.1 — Adaptive Companion Release

item.title: Heliox OS 0.9.0 — JARVIS Autonomy
